components.name: Card
components.description: Raised surface with fine border, layered depth, and inset edge light.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFCF5; color: #20241F; border: 1px solid rgba(32,36,31,0.12); border-radius: 28px; padding: 40px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.85), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(32,36,31,0.025), 0 1px 1px -0.5px rgba(32,36,31,0.08), 0 3px 3px -1.5px rgba(32,36,31,0.06), 0 6px 6px -3px rgba(32,36,31,0.05), 0 12px 12px -6px rgba(32,36,31,0.04), 0 24px 24px -12px rgba(32,36,31,0.04); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-kicker { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; font-weight: 600; color: #65675F; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 40px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -1px; margin-top: 8px; }

components.name: Dark Card
components.description: Ink surface for code and emphasis; coral accents only here.
components.css: .ds-card-dark { background: #20241F; color: #FFF6E8; border: 1px solid rgba(32,36,31,0.65); border-radius: 28px; padding: 40px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,246,232,0.10), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 0 1px 1px -0.5px rgba(32,36,31,0.16), 0 3px 3px -1.5px rgba(32,36,31,0.12), 0 6px 6px -3px rgba(32,36,31,0.09), 0 12px 12px -6px rgba(32,36,31,0.07), 0 24px 24px -12px rgba(32,36,31,0.06); font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 16px; } .ds-card-dark span { color: #FF8A6A; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Outline pill for tags and values.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; color: #20241F; background: #FFFCF5; border: 2px solid #D5D1C6; border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px 20px; }

components.name: Accent Chip
components.description: The one vermilion stamp in a composition.
components.css: .ds-chip-accent { display: inline-block; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; color: #FFF6E8; background: #C63D24; border: 2px solid #C63D24; border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px 20px; }

components.name: Filter Button
components.description: Gallery category filter; ink fill when pressed.
components.css: .ds-filters { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-filter { border: 1px solid #D5D1C6; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 13px; background: transparent; color: #20241F; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter:hover { border-color: #20241F; } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C63D24; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-filter[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #20241F; border-color: #20241F; color: #FFF6E8; } .ds-filter span { margin-left: 10px; opacity: 0.65; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Gallery search field on card stock.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" type="search" placeholder="Search components" aria-label="Search components">
components.css: .ds-search { width: 240px; border: 1px solid #D5D1C6; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 13px; background: #FFFCF5; color: #20241F; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C63D24; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Site Header
components.description: Mono wordmark with vermilion suffix over a hairline rule.
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 28px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #D5D1C6; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #20241F; } .ds-header a { color: inherit; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-header a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C63D24; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-wordmark { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -2px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark span { color: #C63D24; }

components.name: Paper Cut-out
components.description: Signature cut-out: flat card stock with a 2px ink edge and the paper drop.
components.css: .ds-paper-row { display: flex; gap: 32px; padding: 24px; background: #FFF6E8; } .ds-paper { width: 120px; height: 150px; background: #FFFCF5; border: 2px solid #20241F; border-radius: 22px; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px -0.5px rgba(32,36,31,0.08), 0 3px 3px -1.5px rgba(32,36,31,0.06), 0 6px 6px -3px rgba(32,36,31,0.05), 0 12px 12px -6px rgba(32,36,31,0.04), 0 24px 24px -12px rgba(32,36,31,0.04), 0 18px 28px -14px rgba(32,36,31,0.22); } .ds-paper-accent { background: #C63D24; border-color: #C63D24; transform: rotate(-4deg); }

narrative.overview:
Everything in jbm-ui is a flat piece of card stock moved around a cream stage. Shapes are simple and geometric, cut with crisp edges, filled flat, and lifted off the canvas by a soft layered shadow. The system is tactile and plain: it should feel physical without looking realistic, like a paper-craft animation, not an illustration with lighting and texture.

The same pieces render on a web page and in a 1920×1080 or 1080×1920 Remotion stage, so every decision is made in stage pixels and inline styles. Components are deliberately low-detail: minimal contours, no incidental props, and no anatomy beyond what the explanation needs. The content being explained is the subject. The stage and its paper exist to serve it.

The gallery is the stage's backroom. It uses the same palette and type, but it is quieter: thin pencil rules, small mono labels, and transparent controls, so the previews stay the loudest thing on the page.
keyCharacteristics: Two colours: press ink on cream, with one vermilion stamp per composition.
Flat fills and fine ink edges; depth comes only from layered, ink-tinted shadows.
Simple geometric line art; no gradients, textures, or realistic rendering.
Geist for words, Geist Mono for anything measured, labelled, or coded.
Sized in stage pixels and kept inside declared safe areas.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: A composition gets exactly one vermilion accent. If two things are vermilion, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Dark-Only Coral Rule
rules.body: Coral Glow appears only on ink or dark surfaces. On cream, it fails contrast and fights the stamp.

rules.name: The Measured-Things-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Code, labels, counts, and numbers with units use Geist Mono. Prose and headlines never do.

rules.name: The Surfaces-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to cards and paper. Text, chips, and transparent icon controls never gain a shadow.

rules.name: The One Recipe Rule
rules.body: Never hand-write a shadow string in a component; import `shadow`, `shadowLayers`, or `paperShadow`.

dos: Do import colours, radii, shadows, and fonts from `tokens.ts`; keep `globals.css` `--jbm-*` values in sync with it.
Do keep exactly one Stamp Vermilion accent per composition.
Do build illustrations from simple geometric primitives with flat fills and minimal contours.
Do use Geist Mono for labels, counts, code, and numbers with units.
Do inspect beginning, middle, and end frames in both orientations.
donts: Don't add gradients, textures, or realistic anatomy and lighting.
Don't put shadows on text, chips, or transparent icon controls.
Don't use Coral Glow or Code Green on cream.
Don't autoplay or loop motion in the gallery.
Don't duplicate shadow strings or introduce colours outside the palette.
